prompt: A colleague you like often leaves early and leaves their unfinished tasks for you to pick up, and you are falling behind on your own work. What is the most constructive first step?

options.text: Keep doing the extra work silently and complain about them to everyone else on the team
Leave some of your own tasks undone in protest so your manager notices something is wrong
Confront them angrily in front of the whole team so they are embarrassed into changing
Talk to them privately, name the pattern and its impact on your workload, ask for a fairer arrangement, and involve your manager only if it does not change

explanation: A private conversation about the pattern and its impact is fair and gives them a chance to fix it. Silent covering breeds gossip and resentment, while a public confrontation is more likely to make them defensive.
